description:
[Pan-European corporate registry resolver via BRIS. Statutory verification, read-only, side-effect free]. Resolves company registration, national registry jurisdiction, European Unique Identifier (EUID) structure under Directive (EU) 2017/1132, registered office details, and statutory insolvency/liquidation warning flags.
Usage: Use this tool to audit European corporate identity, legal entity status, and official national registry access points across EU Member States.
Returns: JSON object with { countryCode: string, registrationNumber: string, euid: string, legalName: string, nationalRegister: object, companyStatus: string, activeInsolvencyWarning: boolean, brisInterconnectionUrl: string }.

companyNameHint.description: Optional legal company name hint for fuzzy verification

countryCode.description: 2-letter ISO country code of incorporation (e.g. IT, DE, FR, ES, NL)

registrationNumberOrVat.description: National commercial registry number or VAT identifier

name: pan_eu_company_lookup
title: Pan-European Corporate Registry & EUID Resolver (BRIS)
